subject: [PATCH v3 01/11] mm, swap: add virtual swap device infrastructure

2026-08-06.patch_summary: This patch introduces the virtual swap device infrastructure, creating a 16 TB virtual swap device at boot when CONFIG_VSWAP is enabled. It sets up dynamic cluster allocation and adds support for virtual swap devices to the kernel's memory management system. The patch also adds new flags and helpers to handle virtual swap devices efficiently. This is the first in a series of patches that will enable hot paths to skip per-device bookkeeping, implement vswap-aware swap-out and swap-in paths, and integrate with backends such as zswap and physical disks.
